name: singlet_integration_batch_effect_diagnosis
title: Batch-effect diagnosis of unintegrated data
description: Quantifies how strongly batch labels structure an unintegrated PCA embedding, relative to cell type and other covariates. Reports kBET rejection, batch silhouette, PCR, iLISI and per-gene variance fractions as batch magnitudes (higher means more batch), plus per-cell flags. Use it before integration to decide whether correction is needed; it writes diagnostics only, applies no threshold and never changes expression. Do not use it to judge corrected embeddings; use singlet_integration_integration_quality_scoring for those.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

batch_key.description: obs column with the batch label; at least two levels and no missing values.

label_key.description: obs column of cell-type labels for per-label scores and conditioning; null scores globally.

covariates.description: obs columns whose variance fraction is estimated; missing columns are dropped with a warning.

n_pcs.description: Leading PCs of obsm/X_pca scored, and the number of components in the PCR regression.

kbet.description: Options for the kBET neighbourhood test.

graph_k.description: Neighbours in the kNN graph built on obsm/X_pca for the kBET test.

k0.description: Neighbourhood size per test; null applies the scIB per-label rule (quarter of mean batch size, clamped to 10-70).

alpha.description: Significance level of each neighbourhood test.

n_repeat.description: Repeated random test subsets used for the rejection rate.

lisi.description: Options for the local inverse Simpson index.

k0.description: Neighbours for iLISI; perplexity is set to one third of k0.

variance.description: Options for the variance fractions per covariate.

model.description: Variance model: per-gene random effects on log-normalised expression; the only model in this release.

n_genes.description: Highly variable genes (var/hvg_rank order) used by the per-gene variance model.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for kBET test subsets and LMM initialisation; recorded in uns/batch_diagnosis.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running or writing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing uns/batch_diagnosis and per-cell flags instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/batch_diagnosis. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Batch magnitudes (higher means more batch), variance fraction medians per covariate, cell and batch counts, settings and warnings.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
